about.summary: Southwestern Law School is a private law school in Los Angeles, California. It is accredited by the American Bar Association and enrolls nearly 1,000 students. Its campus includes the Bullocks Wilshire building, an Art Deco National Register of Historic Places landmark built in 1929. Southwestern is an independent law school with affiliation to the undergraduate program at California State University, Northridge.

documents.title: Institutional Effectiveness | Southwestern Law School
documents.summary: The page for Southwestern Law School's Institutional Effectiveness details various academic, faculty, administrative, and student life programs. It emphasizes sections on admissions, J.D. and LL.M. programs, curriculum, experiential learning, and career services. It covers essential school attributes like campus services, library access, and alumni engagement, along with the institution's nondiscrimination policies. The page provides comprehensive information regarding school operations, school programs, and legal compliance features including accreditation and privacy policies.
